attchmntText: Rishabh Instruments Limited has informed the Exchange about statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
desc: Statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
voiceSummary: Rishabh Instruments Limited filed a statement on deviation in utilization of funds raised via public issue on 11-09-2023 for Rs. 750.00 million. The deviation is pursuant to a change in objects approved by shareholders on 13-09-2024. For the quarter ended 30.09.2026, funds originally allocated Rs. 621.80 million for Expansion of Nashik Manufacturing Facility I were modified to Rs. 321.80 million, with Rs. 305.89 million utilized. Rs. 300.00 million allocated for Expansion of Nashik Manufacturing Facility II saw Rs. 296.41 million utilized, resulting in a deviation of Rs. 29.01 million. Rs. 79.20 million for General Corporate Purpose was modified to nil, with Rs. 77.21 million utilized. Audit committee and auditor comments are nil.

attchmntText: Rishabh Instruments Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Rishabh Instruments Limited approved its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, on November 13, 2026. Standalone revenue from operations was 880.12 million INR for the quarter and 1,656.11 million INR for the half year. Standalone profit before tax stood at 179.73 million INR for the quarter and 340.22 million INR for the half year. Standalone profit for the period was 135.36 million INR for the quarter and 254.01 million INR for the half year. Basic earnings per share were 3.50 INR for the quarter and 6.57 INR for the half year. The statutory auditors, MSKA & Associates LLP, issued an unmodified review conclusion. The Board also noted the payment of a final dividend of Rs. 2.00 per equity share, approved by shareholders on July 31, 2026.
